about.title: A children's book illustrator and KDP designer who cares about your story
paragraphs: I'm Blessed Olaoluwakiitan, the illustrator and designer behind Blessed KDP-Designzz. I help self-publishing authors, parents, teachers and ministries turn their stories into children's books that kids ask to read again.

My main work is **children's book illustration**: picture books, bedtime stories, faith-based books and early readers, drawn with bright colour and characters full of feeling. Because I also handle **book cover design** and **Amazon KDP formatting**, you work with one person from the first sketch to the final upload, with no hand-offs and no mismatched styles.
I work with authors worldwide and keep you updated at every stage, so you always know what's done and what's next.

items.question: How much does it cost to illustrate a children's book?
items.answer: It depends on how many pages you have, how detailed each scene is and whether you need a cover and formatting too. Send your manuscript and page count and you'll get an exact quote, usually within 24 hours.

items.question: How long does children's book illustration take?
items.answer: Most picture books take a few weeks, depending on page count and how quickly sketches are approved. You'll get a clear timeline before any work starts.

items.question: Will my character look the same on every page?
items.answer: Yes. I start with a character design sheet showing your hero from different angles and with different expressions, and use it for every page.

items.question: Can you design the cover and format the book for Amazon KDP too?
items.answer: Yes. Cover design and KDP formatting are offered as add-ons, so your illustrations, cover and interior all match and are ready to upload.

items.question: What trim sizes do you work with?
items.answer: Any size KDP and IngramSpark support, including popular picture book sizes like 8.5 × 8.5 in and 8.5 × 11 in. Not sure which to pick? I'll recommend one for your story.

items.question: Do I own the rights to the illustrations?
items.answer: Yes. After final payment, you can publish, print and sell your book with the illustrations.

items.question: Can I see sketches before the final illustrations?
items.answer: Always. You approve rough sketches for every page before I move to final colour.

items.question: How do we work together if I live in another country?
items.answer: Everything happens online. We talk on WhatsApp or email, and you can also hire me through Upwork if you prefer to pay on a platform.
